primary_thesis: Given a captured real-site representation, a real robot task, and multiple candidate robot policies, Blueprint can predict a useful ordering of those policies substantially faster and more cheaply than exhaustively evaluating every policy physically, while abstaining when its prediction is not trustworthy.

cosmos_wam_qualification.basis: The exact Blackwell CUDA/BF16 gate and pinned Cosmos3 server load passed. One direct forward-dynamics request returned a decodable 17-frame H.264 clip, but it was 640x528 after a frozen 640x540 request and the frozen deterministic decoder classified it static. Zero qualification canaries were accepted, the same-process Blueprint wrapper was not run, and the paired causal matrix was not admitted.

frozen_benchmark_calibration.basis: The preregistered evaluator admission condition required supported Cosmos qualification. Because qualification failed, GPT-5 mini received no Cosmos rollouts, no new disjoint benchmark split was selected, benchmark outcomes remained sealed, and no ranking statistic can be computed.

captured_site_transfer.basis: No captured-site, 3DGS, egocentric-sim, or site-specific physical outcome arm was run. The only generated clip used the frozen public DROID calibration observation. No prospective site ranking or site abstention was emitted.

economics_and_speed.basis: Provider spend and runtime were measured, but no valid per-policy WAM/evaluator arm completed and no source-supported physical-evaluation time or monetary baseline was available. Substantially faster or cheaper policy evaluation is therefore not established.

overall_decision_rule: The preregistered Cosmos qualification gate did not yield an accepted canary, leaving causal conditioning, ranking calibration, abstention reliability, and captured-site transfer unmeasured. This is insufficient to support the thesis and insufficient to falsify the full thesis with powered valid ranking evidence.

gpu_identity.product_name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

unresolved_contradictions: The runtime evidence says server PID 1273 remained alive and loaded, while the provider retention decision recorded cosmos_server_loaded=false and tore down the instance after the terminal bundle result.
The pinned action path accepts a 540-pixel request but floors its spatial latent height to 33 and returns 528 pixels.
The direct clip is structurally decodable but fails both the frozen exact-dimension contract and the independent frozen static-video check.
The exact-main run worktree matched origin/main, but the user's dirty primary local main ref remained behind and was not destructively changed.

required_causal_changes: Use a height divisible by the pinned spatial VAE factor or patch the pinned runtime to preserve the declared output size, with a new configuration hash and no retroactive pass credit.
Persist direct-generation timing and validation evidence even when validation fails.
Run one 30-step recorded-action canary and one zero-action control before expanding to the ten-arm matrix, with the same frozen motion and causal thresholds.
Repair retained-session handoff so the provider adapter recognizes the loaded server and can apply SHA-bound code-only refreshes without teardown.
cheapest_next_experiment.reason: The v7 authorization was single-use and consumed. A changed follow-up is scientifically justified but must be separately preregistered and admitted.
